ko.title: 900만 유로, 그림 네 점, 5분: 프랑스 리비에라 르누아르 미술관 도난 사건의 내막

segments.src: A brazen, lightning-fast theft at one of France's most cherished small museums has left investigators scrambling and art lovers reeling.
segments.tr: 프랑스에서 가장 사랑받는 소규모 미술관 중 한 곳에서 발생한 대담하고 전격적인 도난 사건으로 인해 수사관들이 비상에 걸리고 미술 애호가들이 큰 충격을 받았습니다.

segments.src: In the span of just a few minutes, thieves made off with four paintings by Pierre-Auguste Renoir from the Musée Renoir in Cagnes-sur-Mer, a picturesque town on the French Riviera where the Impressionist master spent the final years of his life and career.
segments.tr: 단 몇 분 만에 절도범들은 인상주의 거장이 삶과 커리어의 마지막해를 보낸 프랑스 리비에라의 그림 같은 마을 카뉴쉬르메르에 위치한 르누아르 미술관(Musée Renoir)에서 피에르 오귀스트 르누아르의 그림 네 점을 도난해 달아났습니다.

segments.src: ## A Gap in the Fence, a Gap in the Schedule
segments.tr: ## 울타리의 틈새, 근무 일정의 빈틈

segments.src: According to reports from local authorities, the intruders exploited a narrow but critical window of vulnerability: a shift change among the museum's security staff.
segments.tr: 현지 당국의 보고에 따르면, 침입자들은 미술관 보안 직원의 교대 시간이라는 작지만 치명적인 허점을 이용했습니다.

segments.src: Investigators believe the thieves cut through perimeter fencing surrounding the property, slipping onto the grounds of the historic estate, which today operates as a museum dedicated to Renoir's life and work.
segments.tr: 수사관들은 절도범들이 부지를 둘러싼 외곽 울타리를 잘라내고, 오늘날 르누아르의 삶과 작품에 전념하는 미술관으로 운영되는 이 역사적인 저택의 뜰로 몰래 들어간 것으로 보고 있습니다.

segments.src: The entire operation reportedly unfolded in under five minutes — a timeframe that speaks to careful planning and prior knowledge of the site's layout and security routines.
segments.tr: 전체 작전은 5분도 채 되지 않아 펼쳐진 것으로 알려졌으며, 이는 철저한 계획과 현장 구조 및 보안 루틴에 대한 사전 지식이 있었음을 보여줍니다.

segments.src: Four paintings were taken from the galleries before the thieves fled into the surrounding hillside neighborhood.
segments.tr: 절도범들은 도주하여 주변 언덕 마을로 사라지기 전에 갤러리에서 그림 네 점을 가져갔습니다.

segments.src: ## Two Paintings Recovered in the Garden
segments.tr: ## 정원에서 회수된 그림 두 점

segments.src: In a strange twist that has drawn almost as much attention as the theft itself, two of the four stolen works were later found abandoned in the museum's garden, apparently discarded by the fleeing thieves before they could get far.
segments.tr: 도난 사건 자체만큼이나 많은 관심을 끌고 있는 기이한 반전 속에서, 도난당한 작품 네 점 중 두 점은 나중에 미술관 정원에 버려진 채 발견되었는데, 도망치던 절도범들이 멀리 가기 전에 버린 것으로 보입니다.

segments.src: Conservators and museum staff are assessing those two paintings for any damage sustained during the theft and the time spent outdoors, though early indications suggest they survived largely intact.
segments.tr: 보존 전문가들과 미술관 직원들은 도난 과정 및 야외에 방치된 시간 동안 손상이 발생했는지 이 두 그림을 평가하고 있으며, 초기 조사에 따르면 대체로 손상되지 않고 보존된 것으로 보입니다.

segments.src: The other two paintings, however, remain missing.
segments.tr: 그러나 나머지 두 점의 그림은 여전히 행방불명 상태입니다.

segments.src: Together, art experts estimate the value of the works taken — and the two still unaccounted for — at roughly €9 million, underscoring both the cultural and financial stakes of the case.
segments.tr: 미술 전문가들은 가져간 작품들—그리고 여전히 행방이 확인되지 않은 두 점—의 가치를 합쳐 약 €9 million 유로로 추정하며, 이번 사건의 문화적, 재정적 중요성을 모두 강조하고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## A Museum Rooted in History
segments.tr: ## 역사에 뿌리를 둔 미술관

segments.src: The Musée Renoir occupies the artist's former home, the Domaine des Collettes, where he lived and painted from 1907 until his death in 1919.
segments.tr: 르누아르 미술관은 화가가 1907년부터 1919년 사망할 때까지 살며 그림을 그렸던 옛 집인 레 콜레트 저택(Domaine des Collettes)에 자리 잡고 있습니다.

segments.src: The estate, with its olive groves and Mediterranean light that so captivated Renoir, has long been considered a living extension of his work rather than a conventional gallery.
segments.tr: 르누아르를 매료시켰던 올리브 나무 숲과 지중해의 빛이 어우러진 이 저택은 오랫동안 일반적인 갤러리라기보다는 그의 작품이 살아 숨 쉬는 연장선으로 여겨져 왔습니다.

segments.src: That intimate, open character — part of what makes the museum beloved by visitors — may also have contributed to the security challenges investigators are now examining.
segments.tr: 방문객들에게 미술관이 사랑받는 이유 중 하나인 그 친밀하고 개방적인 특성이, 현재 수사관들이 조사 중인 보안상의 취약점으로 작용했을 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: Local officials have acknowledged that the incident is prompting a broader review of security protocols at municipal and regional cultural institutions, particularly smaller museums that hold significant artworks but operate with more limited resources than major national institutions.
segments.tr: 현지 관계자들은 이번 사건으로 인해 지자체 및 지역 문화 기관, 특히 주요 국립 기관보다 제한된 예산으로 운영되면서도 중요한 미술품을 소장하고 있는 소규모 미술관들의 보안 프로토콜에 대한 전반적인 재검토가 이루어지고 있음을 인정했습니다.

segments.src: ## Investigation Underway
segments.tr: ## 수사 진행 중

segments.src: French police are treating the case as an organized theft, noting the speed and precision of the operation as evidence of advance reconnaissance.
segments.tr: 프랑스 경찰은 작전의 속도와 정교함이 사전 정찰의 증거라고 지적하며 이번 사건을 조직적인 절도 사건으로 다루고 있습니다.

segments.src: Investigators are examining surveillance footage, entry points, and the timing of the security shift change in hopes of identifying the culprits and, more urgently, locating the two missing paintings before they can be moved further afield or hidden away in private hands.
segments.tr: 수사관들은 범인을 특정하고, 더 나아가 실종된 두 점의 그림이 더 멀리 이동되거나 개인의 손에 숨겨지기 전에 급히 찾아내기 위해 폐쇄회로 화면, 침입 경로, 보안 교대 시간 등을 면밀히 조사하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Art theft investigators often note that the period immediately following a heist is critical: stolen masterpieces that are not recovered within the first weeks can vanish into black-market networks for years or even decades before resurfacing, if they resurface at all.
segments.tr: 미술품 도난 수사관들은 직후의 기간이 매우 중요하다고 자주 지적합니다. 첫 몇 주 이내에 회수되지 않은 도난 명작은 다시 수면 위로 떠오르더라도 수년 또는 수십 년 동안 암시장 네트워크 속으로 사라질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Interpol and specialized art-crime units are reportedly being consulted as part of the effort to track the missing Renoirs.
segments.tr: 실종된 르누아르 작품들을 추적하기 위한 노력의 일환으로 인터폴과 전담 미술 범죄 전담반의 자문을 구하고 있는 것으로 알려졌습니다.

segments.src: ## Why It Matters
segments.tr: ## 이것이 중요한 이유

segments.src: Beyond the financial loss, the theft strikes at something harder to quantify: public access to a piece of art history that visitors could once view in the very rooms where it was created.
segments.tr: 재정적 손실을 넘어, 이번 도난 사건은 수치로 산정하기 어려운 무언가에 타격을 줍니다. 바로 방문객들이 작품이 탄생한 바로 그 공간에서 관람할 수 있었던 미술사의 한 조각에 대한 대중의 접근성입니다.

segments.src: For now, the Musée Renoir is cooperating fully with the investigation, and officials have expressed cautious hope that the two recovered paintings — and eventually the two still missing — will allow the museum's collection to one day be made whole again.
segments.tr: 현재 르누아르 미술관은 수사에 전적으로 협조하고 있으며, 관계자들은 회수된 두 점의 그림—그리고 언젠가는 여전히 실종 상태인 두 점—을 통해 미술관의 컬렉션이 언젠가 다시 완전해질 수 있기를 조심스럽게 기원하고 있습니다.

zh.title: 900万欧元、四幅画作、五分钟：直击法国里维埃拉雷诺阿博物馆盗窃案

segments.src: A brazen, lightning-fast theft at one of France's most cherished small museums has left investigators scrambling and art lovers reeling.
segments.tr: 法国最受珍视的一家小型博物馆发生了一起胆大包天、迅雷不及掩耳的盗窃案，令调查人员措手不及，也让艺术爱好者们深感震惊。

segments.src: In the span of just a few minutes, thieves made off with four paintings by Pierre-Auguste Renoir from the Musée Renoir in Cagnes-sur-Mer, a picturesque town on the French Riviera where the Impressionist master spent the final years of his life and career.
segments.tr: 在短短几分钟内，盗贼从位于卡涅（Cagnes-sur-Mer）的雷诺阿博物馆（Musée Renoir）盗走了皮埃尔-奥古斯特·雷诺阿（Pierre-Auguste Renoir）的四幅画作。卡涅是法国里维埃拉一座风景如画的小镇，这位印象派大师在此度过了他生命和职业生涯的最后几年。

segments.src: ## A Gap in the Fence, a Gap in the Schedule
segments.tr: ## 围栏的缺口，排班的漏洞

segments.src: According to reports from local authorities, the intruders exploited a narrow but critical window of vulnerability: a shift change among the museum's security staff.
segments.tr: 据当地警方报告，入侵者利用了一个短暂但致命的安全漏洞：博物馆安保人员的交接班时间。

segments.src: Investigators believe the thieves cut through perimeter fencing surrounding the property, slipping onto the grounds of the historic estate, which today operates as a museum dedicated to Renoir's life and work.
segments.tr: 调查人员认为，盗贼剪断了庄园周围的防护围栏，潜入了这处历史遗迹的庭院。如今，这里作为展示雷诺阿生平与作品的博物馆对外开放。

segments.src: The entire operation reportedly unfolded in under five minutes — a timeframe that speaks to careful planning and prior knowledge of the site's layout and security routines.
segments.tr: 据报道，整个作案过程在不到五分钟内完成——这一时间表明盗贼经过了精心策划，并提前掌握了该地点的布局和安保规律。

segments.src: Four paintings were taken from the galleries before the thieves fled into the surrounding hillside neighborhood.
segments.tr: 在盗贼逃往周围的山坡社区之前，有四幅画作从展厅中被盗走。

segments.src: ## Two Paintings Recovered in the Garden
segments.tr: ## 花园中寻回两幅画作

segments.src: In a strange twist that has drawn almost as much attention as the theft itself, two of the four stolen works were later found abandoned in the museum's garden, apparently discarded by the fleeing thieves before they could get far.
segments.tr: 在一个与盗窃案本身一样引人关注的奇特转折中，四幅被盗作品中的两幅随后被发现遗弃在博物馆的花园里，显然是逃跑的盗贼在走远之前丢弃的。

segments.src: Conservators and museum staff are assessing those two paintings for any damage sustained during the theft and the time spent outdoors, though early indications suggest they survived largely intact.
segments.tr: 文物保护人员和博物馆工作人员正在评估这两幅画作在盗窃过程中以及在室外期间是否受损，不过初步迹象表明它们基本完好无损。

segments.src: The other two paintings, however, remain missing.
segments.tr: 然而，另外两幅画作仍然下落不明。

segments.src: Together, art experts estimate the value of the works taken — and the two still unaccounted for — at roughly €9 million, underscoring both the cultural and financial stakes of the case.
segments.tr: 据艺术专家估计，被盗作品（包括仍下落不明的两幅）的总价值约为 900 万欧元，这凸显了此案在文化和经济上的双重重大影响。

segments.src: ## A Museum Rooted in History
segments.tr: ## 植根于历史的博物馆

segments.src: The Musée Renoir occupies the artist's former home, the Domaine des Collettes, where he lived and painted from 1907 until his death in 1919.
segments.tr: 雷诺阿博物馆位于这位艺术家的故居——科莱特庄园（Domaine des Collettes），他从 1907 年起一直在此生活和创作，直至 1919 年去世。

segments.src: The estate, with its olive groves and Mediterranean light that so captivated Renoir, has long been considered a living extension of his work rather than a conventional gallery.
segments.tr: 这处庄园拥有橄榄林和曾令雷诺阿深为着迷的地中海光影，长期以来一直被视为他作品的活生生的延伸，而不仅仅是一个常规的画廊。

segments.src: That intimate, open character — part of what makes the museum beloved by visitors — may also have contributed to the security challenges investigators are now examining.
segments.tr: 这种亲切、开放的特质——也是该博物馆深受游客喜爱的原因之一——可能也给调查人员目前正在审查的安保工作带来了挑战。

segments.src: Local officials have acknowledged that the incident is prompting a broader review of security protocols at municipal and regional cultural institutions, particularly smaller museums that hold significant artworks but operate with more limited resources than major national institutions.
segments.tr: 当地官员承认，这一事件正促使人们对市政和地区文化机构的安保协议进行更广泛的审查，特别是那些收藏有重要艺术品但运营资源比国家级大型机构更为有限的小型博物馆。

segments.src: ## Investigation Underway
segments.tr: ## 调查正在进行中

segments.src: French police are treating the case as an organized theft, noting the speed and precision of the operation as evidence of advance reconnaissance.
segments.tr: 法国警方正将此案作为一起有组织的盗窃案进行处理，并指出作案的速度和精准度表明盗贼曾提前进行过踩点。

segments.src: Investigators are examining surveillance footage, entry points, and the timing of the security shift change in hopes of identifying the culprits and, more urgently, locating the two missing paintings before they can be moved further afield or hidden away in private hands.
segments.tr: 调查人员正在审查监控录像、入境点以及安保交接班的时间，希望能确认犯罪分子的身份，更紧迫的是，在两幅失窃画作被转移到更远的地方或藏匿于私人手中之前找到它们。

segments.src: Art theft investigators often note that the period immediately following a heist is critical: stolen masterpieces that are not recovered within the first weeks can vanish into black-market networks for years or even decades before resurfacing, if they resurface at all.
segments.tr: 艺术品盗窃调查人员经常指出，盗窃案发生后的紧要时期至关重要：如果在最初几周内未能找回被盗的杰作，它们可能会消失在黑市网络中长达数年甚至数十年，然后才重新露面（如果还能重新露面的话）。

segments.src: Interpol and specialized art-crime units are reportedly being consulted as part of the effort to track the missing Renoirs.
segments.tr: 据报道，作为追踪失窃雷诺阿画作工作的一部分，警方正在咨询国际刑警组织和专门的艺术犯罪调查部门。

segments.src: ## Why It Matters
segments.tr: ## 为什么这很重要

segments.src: Beyond the financial loss, the theft strikes at something harder to quantify: public access to a piece of art history that visitors could once view in the very rooms where it was created.
segments.tr: 除了经济损失之外，这次盗窃还打击了更难量化的东西：公众接触一段艺术史的机会，而游客曾经可以在这些作品诞生的房间里亲自观赏它们。

segments.src: For now, the Musée Renoir is cooperating fully with the investigation, and officials have expressed cautious hope that the two recovered paintings — and eventually the two still missing — will allow the museum's collection to one day be made whole again.
segments.tr: 目前，雷诺阿博物馆正全力配合调查，官员们表示谨慎乐观，希望找回的两幅画作——以及最终仍下落不明的两幅画作——能让博物馆的藏品有朝一日重新完整。

segments.src: Investigators are examining surveillance footage, entry points, and the timing of the security shift change in hopes of identifying the culprits and, more urgently, locating the two missing paintings before they can be moved further afield or hidden away in private hands.
segments.tr: जांचकर्ता दोषियों की पहचान करने की उम्मीद में निगरानी फुटेज, प्रवेश बिंदुओं और सुरक्षा बदलाव के समय की जांच कर रहे हैं, और अधिक जरूरी है कि दो लापता पेंटिंग का पता लगाया जाए, इससे पहले कि उन्हें आगे ले जाया जा सके या निजी हाथों में छिपाया जा सके।

segments.src: Art theft investigators often note that the period immediately following a heist is critical: stolen masterpieces that are not recovered within the first weeks can vanish into black-market networks for years or even decades before resurfacing, if they resurface at all.
segments.tr: कला चोरी के जांचकर्ता अक्सर यह नोट करते हैं कि चोरी के तुरंत बाद की अवधि महत्वपूर्ण होती है: चोरी की गई उत्कृष्ट कृतियां जो पहले हफ्तों के भीतर बरामद नहीं की जाती हैं, पुनरुत्थान होने पर, वर्षों या दशकों के लिए ब्लैक-मार्केट नेटवर्क में गायब हो सकती हैं।

segments.src: ## Why It Matters
segments.tr: ## Why It Matters

segments.src: Beyond the financial loss, the theft strikes at something harder to quantify: public access to a piece of art history that visitors could once view in the very rooms where it was created.
segments.tr: वित्तीय नुकसान से परे, चोरी कला इतिहास के एक टुकड़े तक सार्वजनिक पहुंच को प्रभावित करती है जिसे आगंतुक एक बार उन कमरों में देख सकते थे जहाँ इसे बनाया गया था।

segments.src: For now, the Musée Renoir is cooperating fully with the investigation, and officials have expressed cautious hope that the two recovered paintings — and eventually the two still missing — will allow the museum's collection to one day be made whole again.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, मुसी रेनॉयर जांच के साथ पूरी तरह से सहयोग कर रहा है, और अधिकारियों ने सतर्क आशा व्यक्त की है कि दो बरामद पेंटिंग - और अंततः दो अभी भी गायब हैं - संग्रहालय के संग्रह को एक दिन फिर से पूरा करने की अनुमति देंगे।

es.title: 9 millones de euros, cuatro cuadros, cinco minutos: dentro del robo al Museo Renoir en la Riviera Francesa

segments.src: A brazen, lightning-fast theft at one of France's most cherished small museums has left investigators scrambling and art lovers reeling.
segments.tr: Un robo descarado y rapidísimo en uno de los pequeños museos más queridos de Francia ha dejado a los investigadores desconcertados y a los amantes del arte conmocionados.

segments.src: In the span of just a few minutes, thieves made off with four paintings by Pierre-Auguste Renoir from the Musée Renoir in Cagnes-sur-Mer, a picturesque town on the French Riviera where the Impressionist master spent the final years of his life and career.
segments.tr: En el espacio de apenas unos minutos, los ladrones se llevaron cuatro cuadros de Pierre-Auguste Renoir del Musée Renoir en Cagnes-sur-Mer, un pintoresco pueblo de la Riviera Francesa donde el maestro impresionista pasó los últimos años de su vida y carrera.

segments.src: ## A Gap in the Fence, a Gap in the Schedule
segments.tr: ## Un hueco en la valla, un hueco en el horario

segments.src: According to reports from local authorities, the intruders exploited a narrow but critical window of vulnerability: a shift change among the museum's security staff.
segments.tr: Según informes de las autoridades locales, los intrusos aprovecharon una ventana de vulnerabilidad estrecha pero crucial: un cambio de turno entre el personal de seguridad del museo.

segments.src: Investigators believe the thieves cut through perimeter fencing surrounding the property, slipping onto the grounds of the historic estate, which today operates as a museum dedicated to Renoir's life and work.
segments.tr: Los investigadores creen que los ladrones cortaron la valla perimetral que rodea la propiedad, adentrándose en los terrenos de la finca histórica, que hoy funciona como museo dedicado a la vida y obra de Renoir.

segments.src: The entire operation reportedly unfolded in under five minutes — a timeframe that speaks to careful planning and prior knowledge of the site's layout and security routines.
segments.tr: Toda la operación se desarrolló supuestamente en menos de cinco minutos, un marco de tiempo que habla de una planificación cuidadosa y un conocimiento previo de la disposición del sitio y las rutinas de seguridad.

segments.src: Four paintings were taken from the galleries before the thieves fled into the surrounding hillside neighborhood.
segments.tr: Cuatro cuadros fueron sustraídos de las galerías antes de que los ladrones huyeran hacia el vecindario de la colina circundante.

segments.src: ## Two Paintings Recovered in the Garden
segments.tr: ## Dos cuadros recuperados en el jardín

segments.src: In a strange twist that has drawn almost as much attention as the theft itself, two of the four stolen works were later found abandoned in the museum's garden, apparently discarded by the fleeing thieves before they could get far.
segments.tr: En un extraño giro que ha atraído casi tanta atención como el robo en sí, dos de las cuatro obras robadas fueron encontradas más tarde abandonadas en el jardín del museo, aparentemente descartadas por los ladrones que huían antes de poder llegar muy lejos.

segments.src: Conservators and museum staff are assessing those two paintings for any damage sustained during the theft and the time spent outdoors, though early indications suggest they survived largely intact.
segments.tr: Los conservadores y el personal del museo están evaluando esos dos cuadros en busca de cualquier daño sufrido durante el robo y el tiempo pasado al aire libre, aunque los primeros indicios sugieren que sobrevivieron en gran parte intactos.

segments.src: The other two paintings, however, remain missing.
segments.tr: Sin embargo, los otros dos cuadros siguen desaparecidos.

segments.src: Together, art experts estimate the value of the works taken — and the two still unaccounted for — at roughly €9 million, underscoring both the cultural and financial stakes of the case.
segments.tr: En conjunto, los expertos en arte estiman el valor de las obras sustraídas —y las dos aún no localizadas— en aproximadamente 9 millones de euros, lo que subraya tanto lo cultural como lo financiero en juego en este caso.

segments.src: ## A Museum Rooted in History
segments.tr: ## Un museo arraigado en la historia

segments.tr: Los funcionarios locales han reconocido que el incidente está impulsando una revisión más amplia de los protocolos de seguridad en las instituciones culturales municipales y regionales, particularmente en los museos más pequeños que albergan obras de arte importantes pero operan con recursos más limitados que las grandes instituciones nacionales.

segments.tr: هذه الطبيعة الحميمة والمفتوحة - وهي جزء مما يجعل المتحف محبوباً من قبل الزوار - ربما ساهمت أيضاً في التحديات الأمنية التي يدرسها المحققون الآن.

segments.src: ## Investigation Underway

segments.tr: تتعامل الشرطة الفرنسية مع القضية كسرقة منظمة، مشيرة إلى سرعة ودقة العملية كدليل على وجود استطلاع مسبق.

segments.src: For now, the Musée Renoir is cooperating fully with the investigation, and officials have expressed cautious hope that the two recovered paintings — and eventually the two still missing — will allow the museum's collection to one day be made whole again.
segments.tr: في الوقت الحالي، يتعاون متحف رينوار بشكل كامل مع التحقيق، وقد أعرب المسؤولون عن أمل حذر في أن اللوحتين اللتين تم استعادتهما - وفي النهاية اللوحتين اللتين لا تزالان مفقودتين - ستسمحان لمجموعة المتحف بأن تكتمل مرة أخرى يوماً ما.

fr.title: 9 millions d'euros, quatre tableaux, cinq minutes : dans les coulisses du cambriolage du musée Renoir sur la Côte d'Azur

segments.src: A brazen, lightning-fast theft at one of France's most cherished small museums has left investigators scrambling and art lovers reeling.
segments.tr: Un vol audacieux et fulgurant dans l'un des petits musées les plus chers de France a laissé les enquêteurs perplexes et les amateurs d'art sous le choc.

segments.src: In the span of just a few minutes, thieves made off with four paintings by Pierre-Auguste Renoir from the Musée Renoir in Cagnes-sur-Mer, a picturesque town on the French Riviera where the Impressionist master spent the final years of his life and career.
segments.tr: En l'espace de quelques minutes seulement, des voleurs se sont emparés de quatre tableaux de Pierre-Auguste Renoir au Musée Renoir de Cagnes-sur-Mer, une ville pittoresque de la Côte d'Azur où le maître impressionniste a passé les dernières années de sa vie et de sa carrière.

segments.src: ## A Gap in the Fence, a Gap in the Schedule
segments.tr: ## Une brèche dans la clôture, une faille dans l'emploi du temps

segments.src: According to reports from local authorities, the intruders exploited a narrow but critical window of vulnerability: a shift change among the museum's security staff.
segments.tr: Selon les rapports des autorités locales, les intrus ont exploité une fenêtre de vulnérabilité étroite mais critique : un changement d'équipe parmi le personnel de sécurité du musée.

segments.src: Investigators believe the thieves cut through perimeter fencing surrounding the property, slipping onto the grounds of the historic estate, which today operates as a museum dedicated to Renoir's life and work.
segments.tr: Les enquêteurs pensent que les voleurs ont découpé la clôture périmétrique entourant la propriété, se faufilant sur le terrain du domaine historique, qui fonctionne aujourd'hui comme un musée dédié à la vie et à l'œuvre de Renoir.

segments.src: The entire operation reportedly unfolded in under five minutes — a timeframe that speaks to careful planning and prior knowledge of the site's layout and security routines.
segments.tr: L'opération entière se serait déroulée en moins de cinq minutes — un laps de temps qui témoigne d'une planification minutieuse et d'une connaissance préalable de la disposition et des routines de sécurité du site.

segments.src: Four paintings were taken from the galleries before the thieves fled into the surrounding hillside neighborhood.
segments.tr: Quatre tableaux ont été retirés des galeries avant que les voleurs ne s'enfuient dans le quartier vallonné environnant.

segments.src: ## Two Paintings Recovered in the Garden
segments.tr: ## Deux tableaux retrouvés dans le jardin

segments.src: In a strange twist that has drawn almost as much attention as the theft itself, two of the four stolen works were later found abandoned in the museum's garden, apparently discarded by the fleeing thieves before they could get far.
segments.tr: Dans un étrange rebondissement qui a attiré presque autant l'attention que le vol lui-même, deux des quatre œuvres volées ont été retrouvées plus tard abandonnées dans le jardin du musée, apparemment jetées par les voleurs en fuite avant qu'ils ne puissent aller bien loin.

segments.src: Conservators and museum staff are assessing those two paintings for any damage sustained during the theft and the time spent outdoors, though early indications suggest they survived largely intact.
segments.tr: Les conservateurs et le personnel du musée évaluent ces deux tableaux pour détecter tout dommage subi pendant le vol et le temps passé à l'extérieur, bien que les premières indications suggèrent qu'ils ont survécu en grande partie intacts.

segments.src: The other two paintings, however, remain missing.
segments.tr: Les deux autres tableaux, cependant, restent introuvables.

segments.src: Together, art experts estimate the value of the works taken — and the two still unaccounted for — at roughly €9 million, underscoring both the cultural and financial stakes of the case.
segments.tr: Au total, les experts en art estiment la valeur des œuvres emportées — et des deux toujours portées disparues — à environ 9 millions d'euros, soulignant à la fois les enjeux culturels et financiers de l'affaire.

segments.src: ## A Museum Rooted in History
segments.tr: ## Un musée ancré dans l'histoire

segments.src: The Musée Renoir occupies the artist's former home, the Domaine des Collettes, where he lived and painted from 1907 until his death in 1919.
segments.tr: Le Musée Renoir occupe l'ancienne demeure de l'artiste, le Domaine des Collettes, où il a vécu et peint de 1907 jusqu'à sa mort en 1919.

segments.src: The estate, with its olive groves and Mediterranean light that so captivated Renoir, has long been considered a living extension of his work rather than a conventional gallery.
segments.tr: Le domaine, avec ses oliveraies et la lumière méditerranéenne qui a tant captivé Renoir, a longtemps été considéré comme une extension vivante de son travail plutôt que comme une galerie conventionnelle.

segments.src: That intimate, open character — part of what makes the museum beloved by visitors — may also have contributed to the security challenges investigators are now examining.
segments.tr: Ce caractère intime et ouvert — qui fait partie de ce qui rend le musée apprécié des visiteurs — a peut-être aussi contribué aux défis de sécurité que les enquêteurs examinent actuellement.

segments.src: Local officials have acknowledged that the incident is prompting a broader review of security protocols at municipal and regional cultural institutions, particularly smaller museums that hold significant artworks but operate with more limited resources than major national institutions.
segments.tr: Les responsables locaux ont reconnu que l'incident incite à un examen plus large des protocoles de sécurité dans les institutions culturelles municipales et régionales, en particulier les petits musées qui détiennent des œuvres d'art importantes mais fonctionnent avec des ressources plus limitées que les grandes institutions nationales.

segments.src: ## Investigation Underway
segments.tr: ## Enquête en cours

segments.src: French police are treating the case as an organized theft, noting the speed and precision of the operation as evidence of advance reconnaissance.
segments.tr: La police française traite l'affaire comme un vol organisé, notant la rapidité et la précision de l'opération comme preuve d'une reconnaissance préalable.

segments.src: Investigators are examining surveillance footage, entry points, and the timing of the security shift change in hopes of identifying the culprits and, more urgently, locating the two missing paintings before they can be moved further afield or hidden away in private hands.
segments.tr: Les enquêteurs examinent les images de vidéosurveillance, les points d'entrée et le timing du changement d'équipe de sécurité dans l'espoir d'identifier les coupables et, plus urgemment, de localiser les deux tableaux manquants avant qu'ils ne puissent être déplacés plus loin ou cachés dans des mains privées.

segments.src: Art theft investigators often note that the period immediately following a heist is critical: stolen masterpieces that are not recovered within the first weeks can vanish into black-market networks for years or even decades before resurfacing, if they resurface at all.
segments.tr: Les enquêteurs spécialisés dans le vol d'art notent souvent que la période suivant immédiatement un cambriolage est critique : les chefs-d'œuvre volés qui ne sont pas récupérés dans les premières semaines peuvent disparaître dans les réseaux du marché noir pendant des années, voire des décennies, avant de refaire surface, s'ils refont surface un jour.

segments.src: Interpol and specialized art-crime units are reportedly being consulted as part of the effort to track the missing Renoirs.
segments.tr: Interpol et des unités spécialisées dans les crimes contre l'art seraient consultés dans le cadre des efforts pour retrouver les Renoir disparus.

segments.src: ## Why It Matters
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi c'est important

segments.src: Beyond the financial loss, the theft strikes at something harder to quantify: public access to a piece of art history that visitors could once view in the very rooms where it was created.
segments.tr: Au-delà de la perte financière, le vol frappe quelque chose de plus difficile à quantifier : l'accès du public à un pan de l'histoire de l'art que les visiteurs pouvaient autrefois admirer dans les pièces mêmes où il a été créé.

segments.src: For now, the Musée Renoir is cooperating fully with the investigation, and officials have expressed cautious hope that the two recovered paintings — and eventually the two still missing — will allow the museum's collection to one day be made whole again.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, le Musée Renoir coopère pleinement à l'enquête, et les responsables ont exprimé l'espoir prudent que les deux tableaux récupérés — et éventuellement les deux toujours manquants — permettront à la collection du musée d'être un jour reconstituée.

ja.title: 900万ユーロ、4点の絵画、5分間：フレンチ・リヴィエラのルノワール美術館強盗事件の全貌

segments.src: A brazen, lightning-fast theft at one of France's most cherished small museums has left investigators scrambling and art lovers reeling.
segments.tr: フランスで最も愛されている小規模な美術館の一つで起きた、大胆かつ電光石火の盗難事件により、捜査当局は対応に追われ、美術愛好家たちは大きな衝撃を受けています。

segments.src: In the span of just a few minutes, thieves made off with four paintings by Pierre-Auguste Renoir from the Musée Renoir in Cagnes-sur-Mer, a picturesque town on the French Riviera where the Impressionist master spent the final years of his life and career.
segments.tr: わずか数分のうちに、泥棒たちはコート・ダジュールの絵画のような美しい町カニュ・シュル・メールにあるルノワール美術館から、印象派の巨匠が人生とキャリアの晩年を過ごしたピエール＝オーギュスト・ルノワールの絵画4点を持ち去りました。

segments.src: ## A Gap in the Fence, a Gap in the Schedule
segments.tr: ## 柵の隙間、スケジュールの隙間

segments.src: According to reports from local authorities, the intruders exploited a narrow but critical window of vulnerability: a shift change among the museum's security staff.
segments.tr: 地元当局の報告によると、侵入者たちはわずかでありながら極めて重大な脆弱性の時間帯、すなわち美術館の警備スタッフのシフト交代の隙を突きました。

segments.src: Investigators believe the thieves cut through perimeter fencing surrounding the property, slipping onto the grounds of the historic estate, which today operates as a museum dedicated to Renoir's life and work.
segments.tr: 捜査当局は、泥棒たちが敷地を取り囲む周囲のフェンスを切断し、ルノワールの生涯と作品を専門とする美術館として現在運営されている歴史的な敷地内に忍び込んだとみています。

segments.src: The entire operation reportedly unfolded in under five minutes — a timeframe that speaks to careful planning and prior knowledge of the site's layout and security routines.
segments.tr: 犯行全体は5分未満で実行されたと伝えられており、敷地のレイアウトや警備のルーティンに関する綿密な計画と事前の知識があったことを物語っています。

segments.src: Four paintings were taken from the galleries before the thieves fled into the surrounding hillside neighborhood.
segments.tr: 泥棒たちが周囲の丘陵地の住宅街へと逃走する前に、ギャラリーから4点の絵画が持ち去られました。

segments.src: ## Two Paintings Recovered in the Garden
segments.tr: 盗難事件自体と同等以上の注目を集めている奇妙な展開として、盗まれた4作品のうち2点が後に美術館の庭で放置されているのが発見されました。どうやら逃走する泥棒たちが遠くへ持ち運ぶ前に捨てたものとみられます。

segments.src: In a strange twist that has drawn almost as much attention as the theft itself, two of the four stolen works were later found abandoned in the museum's garden, apparently discarded by the fleeing thieves before they could get far.
segments.tr: 修復家や美術館のスタッフは、盗難中および屋外で過ごした時間に受けた損傷がないかこれら2点の絵画を評価していますが、初期の兆候から、ほぼ無傷のままであったことが示唆されています。

segments.src: Conservators and museum staff are assessing those two paintings for any damage sustained during the theft and the time spent outdoors, though early indications suggest they survived largely intact.
segments.tr: しかし、残りの2点の絵画は依然として行方不明です。

segments.src: The other two paintings, however, remain missing.
segments.tr: 美術専門家は、持ち去られた作品とまだ行方不明の2点を合わせた価値を約900万ユーロと見積もっており、この事件の文化的および財政的賭けの大きさを浮き彫りにしています。

segments.src: Together, art experts estimate the value of the works taken — and the two still unaccounted for — at roughly €9 million, underscoring both the cultural and financial stakes of the case.

segments.src: The Musée Renoir occupies the artist's former home, the Domaine des Collettes, where he lived and painted from 1907 until his death in 1919.
segments.tr: オリーブ畑とルノワールを魅了した地中海の光に満ちたこの敷地は、従来のギャラリーというよりも、彼の作品の生きた延長線上に長年見なされてきました。

segments.src: The estate, with its olive groves and Mediterranean light that so captivated Renoir, has long been considered a living extension of his work rather than a conventional gallery.
segments.tr: その親密で開かれた性格（訪問者に美術館が愛されている理由の一部）は、捜査当局が現在調査している警備上の課題の一因となった可能性もあります。

segments.src: That intimate, open character — part of what makes the museum beloved by visitors — may also have contributed to the security challenges investigators are now examining.
segments.tr: 地方自治体の当局者は、この事件を契機として、地方および地域の文化施設、特に重要な美術品を所蔵していながらも大規模な国立施設よりも限られた資源で運営されている小規模な美術館における警備プロトコルのより広範な見直しが進められていることを認めています。

segments.src: Local officials have acknowledged that the incident is prompting a broader review of security protocols at municipal and regional cultural institutions, particularly smaller museums that hold significant artworks but operate with more limited resources than major national institutions.

segments.tr: Trong một diễn biến kỳ lạ thu hút sự chú ý gần như ngang ngửa bản thân vụ trộm, hai trong số bốn tác phẩm bị mất trộm sau đó đã được tìm thấy khi bị bỏ lại trong vườn của bảo tàng, có vẻ như do kẻ trộm vứt bỏ trước khi kịp tẩu thoát xa.

segments.src: Conservators and museum staff are assessing those two paintings for any damage sustained during the theft and the time spent outdoors, though early indications suggest they survived largely intact.
segments.tr: Các chuyên gia bảo tồn và nhân viên bảo tàng đang đánh giá hai bức tranh này xem có bị hư hại gì trong quá trình trộm và thời gian ở ngoài trời hay không, mặc dù những dấu hiệu ban đầu cho thấy chúng hầu như còn nguyên vẹn.

segments.src: The other two paintings, however, remain missing.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, hai bức tranh còn lại vẫn đang mất tích.

segments.src: Together, art experts estimate the value of the works taken — and the two still unaccounted for — at roughly €9 million, underscoring both the cultural and financial stakes of the case.
segments.tr: Cùng nhau, các chuyên gia nghệ thuật ước tính giá trị của các tác phẩm bị lấy đi — và hai bức vẫn chưa tìm thấy — vào khoảng 9 triệu €, nhấn mạnh cả rủi ro về mặt văn hóa lẫn tài chính của vụ án.

segments.src: ## A Museum Rooted in History
segments.tr: ## Một bảo tàng gắn liền với lịch sử

segments.src: The Musée Renoir occupies the artist's former home, the Domaine des Collettes, where he lived and painted from 1907 until his death in 1919.
segments.tr: Bảo tàng Renoir tọa lạc tại ngôi nhà cũ của họa sĩ, Domaine des Collettes, nơi ông đã sống và sáng tác từ năm 1907 cho đến khi qua đời vào năm 1919.

segments.src: The estate, with its olive groves and Mediterranean light that so captivated Renoir, has long been considered a living extension of his work rather than a conventional gallery.
segments.tr: Khu trang trại, với những rặng ô liu và ánh sáng Địa Trung Hải từng mê hoặc Renoir, từ lâu đã được coi là một phần mở rộng sống động cho các tác phẩm của ông chứ không chỉ là một phòng trưng bày thông thường.

segments.src: That intimate, open character — part of what makes the museum beloved by visitors — may also have contributed to the security challenges investigators are now examining.
segments.tr: Chính nét ấm cúng, mở cửa đó — một phần lý do khiến bảo tàng được du khách yêu mến — cũng có thể đã góp phần tạo ra những thách thức về an ninh mà các điều tra viên hiện đang xem xét.

segments.src: Local officials have acknowledged that the incident is prompting a broader review of security protocols at municipal and regional cultural institutions, particularly smaller museums that hold significant artworks but operate with more limited resources than major national institutions.
segments.tr: Các quan chức địa phương thừa nhận rằng sự cố này đang thúc đẩy một đợt rà soát diện rộng đối với các quy trình an ninh tại các thiết chế văn hóa cấp đô thị và khu vực, đặc biệt là các bảo tàng nhỏ hơn sở hữu những tác phẩm nghệ thuật giá trị nhưng hoạt động với nguồn lực hạn chế hơn so với các bảo tàng quốc gia lớn.

segments.src: ## Investigation Underway
segments.tr: ## Cuộc điều tra đang tiến hành

segments.src: French police are treating the case as an organized theft, noting the speed and precision of the operation as evidence of advance reconnaissance.
segments.tr: Cảnh sát Pháp đang xử lý vụ án như một vụ trộm có tổ chức, lưu ý tốc độ và sự chính xác của chiến dịch là bằng chứng cho thấy có sự trinh sát từ trước.

segments.src: Investigators are examining surveillance footage, entry points, and the timing of the security shift change in hopes of identifying the culprits and, more urgently, locating the two missing paintings before they can be moved further afield or hidden away in private hands.
segments.tr: Các điều tra viên đang xem xét lại hình ảnh camera giám sát, các điểm xâm nhập và thời điểm giao ca bảo vệ với hy vọng nhận diện được thủ phạm và khẩn cấp hơn là xác định vị trí của hai bức tranh mất tích trước khi chúng bị chuyển đi xa hơn hoặc cất giấu trong tay tư nhân.

segments.src: Art theft investigators often note that the period immediately following a heist is critical: stolen masterpieces that are not recovered within the first weeks can vanish into black-market networks for years or even decades before resurfacing, if they resurface at all.
segments.tr: Các điều tra viên vụ án trộm nghệ thuật thường lưu ý rằng khoảng thời gian ngay sau vụ trộm là cực kỳ quan trọng: các kiệt tác bị trộm nếu không được thu hồi trong những tuần đầu tiên có thể biến mất vào các mạng lưới chợ đen trong nhiều năm hoặc thậm chí nhiều thập kỷ trước khi xuất hiện lại, nếu chúng có thể xuất hiện lại.

segments.src: Interpol and specialized art-crime units are reportedly being consulted as part of the effort to track the missing Renoirs.
segments.tr: Interpol và các đơn vị chuyên trách về tội phạm nghệ thuật được cho là đang được tham vấn như một phần của nỗ lực truy tìm các bức tranh Renoir bị mất tích.

segments.src: ## Why It Matters
segments.tr: ## Tại sao điều này lại quan trọng

segments.src: Beyond the financial loss, the theft strikes at something harder to quantify: public access to a piece of art history that visitors could once view in the very rooms where it was created.
segments.tr: Vượt lên trên tổn thất tài chính, vụ trộm đụng chạm đến một điều khó định lượng hơn: khả năng tiếp cận của công chúng đối với một phần lịch sử nghệ thuật mà du khách từng có thể thưởng lãm ngay trong chính những căn phòng nơi nó được tạo ra.

segments.src: For now, the Musée Renoir is cooperating fully with the investigation, and officials have expressed cautious hope that the two recovered paintings — and eventually the two still missing — will allow the museum's collection to one day be made whole again.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, Bảo tàng Renoir đang hợp tác đầy đủ với cuộc điều tra, và các quan chức đã bày tỏ hy vọng thận trọng rằng hai bức tranh được tìm thấy — và cuối cùng là hai bức vẫn còn mất tích — sẽ cho phép bộ sưu tập của bảo tàng một ngày nào đó trở lại trọn vẹn.
